supported_scope: Native artifact views show plans and diffs, and inline feedback can redirect proposed work. App-wide stop/cancel semantics are not established by these sources.
unestablished_scope: Cancellation control and effect on already-running processes or external actions
required_setup: Open artifact review and provide feedback before proceeding; review policy determines where work pauses.
constraints: CLI Escape interruption instructions are not evidence of an App cancellation mechanism.
